# RackMatch

> RackMatch names the IEC jumper between a server PSU inlet and a PDU outlet. It does not sell power cords.

The inlet on the installed power supply decides the cord. The chassis name alone does not.

- C14 inlet: C13 coupler into the server, C14 plug into a PDU C13 outlet. 10 A class.
- C20 inlet: C19 coupler into the server, C20 plug into a PDU C19 outlet. 16 A class.
- A C13 cord does not mate with a C20 inlet.

Check the live nameplate. A high-watt PSU in the same chassis can use C20 instead of C14.
